title: docs: layout.md names the object-grid object with objectName, and flex.mdx teaches the four direction values (objectui#11298)
body:
Fixes #11298
Clause-②: no

Two docs snippets taught a key and a value that `objectui validate` refuses. This PR corrects both in today's flat spelling, and nothing else.

| Site | Taught | Now teaches |
|---|---|---|
| `content/docs/guide/layout.md`, the "With Action Buttons" snippet, its `object-grid` node | `"object": "products"` | `"objectName": "products"` |
| `content/docs/components/layout/flex.mdx`, the Schema block, `direction` | `'row' \| 'column'` | `'row' \| 'col' \| 'row-reverse' \| 'col-reverse'` |

- There is no alias and no renderer fallback for `object` or `column`. The validator is right, and the docs were wrong.
- Both hunks are one line each. The layout.md hunk stays on the snippet's own line, so it does not touch the prose after the snippet that draft objectui#11069 edits.
- `FlexSchema.direction` declares the four values above, and the flex renderer maps each one to a class (`flex-row`, `flex-col`, `flex-row-reverse`, `flex-col-reverse`). It has no branch for `column`.

## Measured before and after (head `680a2be4b4`)

The probe reads both snippets from the docs on disk and runs `safeValidateSchema` from `packages/types/src/zod/index.zod.ts` on them. That is the function `objectui validate` calls. The probe lives in the scratchpad and is not committed.

Before, on base `caa0cd3927`:

```text
layout.md "With Action Buttons" (verbatim): FAIL [{"path":"children","code":"invalid_union","message":"Invalid input"}]
  object-grid node alone: FAIL [{"path":"objectName","code":"invalid_type","message":"Invalid input: expected string, received undefined"}]
flex.mdx direction line: direction?: 'row' | 'column';
  { type: 'flex', direction: 'row' }: PASS
  { type: 'flex', direction: 'column' }: FAIL [{"path":"direction","code":"invalid_value","message":"Invalid option: expected one of \"row\"|\"col\"|\"row-reverse\"|\"col-reverse\""}]
```

After:

```text
layout.md "With Action Buttons" (verbatim): PASS
  object-grid node alone: PASS
flex.mdx direction line: direction?: 'row' | 'col' | 'row-reverse' | 'col-reverse';
  { type: 'flex', direction: 'row' }: PASS
  { type: 'flex', direction: 'col' }: PASS
  { type: 'flex', direction: 'row-reverse' }: PASS
  { type: 'flex', direction: 'col-reverse' }: PASS
```

On the strict authoring face (`StrictAnyComponentSchema`), the fixed "With Action Buttons" snippet passes, and so does `{ type: 'flex', direction: 'col' }`. The controls stay red: `direction: 'column'` fails `invalid_value`, and `{ type: 'object-grid', object: 'products' }` fails both `objectName invalid_type` and `unrecognized_keys: object`.

## Other copies

A census of every `object-grid` node literal (in any fence language) and every `direction` taught as a quoted `column` covered `content/docs/**` and every tracked `README.md` (257 files, 48 `object-grid` literals). It found exactly one copy of each mistake, and this PR fixes both. After the fix, both counts read 0.

## Do the repo's snippet checks reach these fences? No, so no pin is added

- `check:doc-snippets` compiles `ts` / `tsx` fences only. Its header names schema-key validity as blind spot 1.
- The layout.md snippet is a `json` fence. The flex.mdx block is a `plaintext` fence that `check:doc-fences` lists in its declared shrink-only debt (the objectui#5867 lane).
- `check:doc-types` reads the `type` literal only. `check:doc-examples` reads JSDoc `@example` blocks under `packages/*/src` only.
- The tests that read layout.md's `json` fences (`page-actions-refusal-7926.test.ts`, `guide-layout-page-buttons-7926.test.tsx`) assert `actions` and `children`, and that the buttons render. None of them runs `safeValidateSchema`.

The ruling made a snippet pin conditional on a snippet check reaching these fences, and no check reaches them. So no pin and no new gate are added.

## Checks (run at `680a2be4b4`)

- The 23 test files that `node scripts/markdown-test-inputs.mjs --list` records as reading either edited file, run under the verify lock from the repo root with `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` and those 23 paths: `Test Files  23 passed (23)`, `Tests  851 passed (851)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm check:doc-fences` exits 0: "every TypeScript block in 227 document(s) is fenced ts/tsx/typescript, except 72 declared file(s)…".
- `pnpm check:doc-types` exits 0: "Every documented component type is registered."
- `node scripts/check-doc-links.mjs` exits 0: "Links are valid across 17 scan roots."
- `pnpm check:control-bytes` exits 0: "OK (scanned 9780 tracked text file(s); skipped 85 binary)".
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` exits 0: "No source or published contract of a released package changed in this range, so no changeset is owed."
- `pnpm changeset:check` exits 0.
- `pnpm check:new-line-citations` exits 0: "0 new citation(s)".
- `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` on both paths reports NOT GOVERNED.
- `pnpm check:doc-snippets` is **NOT MEASURED**. It exited 2 with PRECONDITION NOT MET because its 34-package build closure is not built in this container, and that build does not fit the foreground cap. This diff changes no `ts`/`tsx` fence, so the gate's population is untouched. CI's `doc-snippet-types.yml` builds the closure and runs it.
- Lint: eslint's own answer for both edited files is "File ignored because no matching configuration was supplied", so this diff has no lint population. The repo-wide lint run belongs to CI.

No changeset is added: docs are not a released package, and the presence gate agrees. ⛔ No `skip-changeset` label, because nothing in this repo reads it.

## Acceptance notes

- **Coupling.** objectui#11276's `object-grid` batch may later move this node into the `properties` bag, and `flex.mdx` is part of the objectui#11300 decision's corpus. This PR corrects the key and the value in the flat spelling only. Whichever batch moves the node later carries the corrected key.
- **Other lines in flex.mdx's Schema block.** `align` and `justify` list a subset of what `FlexSchema` accepts (`baseline`/`stretch`, `around`/`evenly` are missing). `children` is shown as required, but the schema makes it optional and accepts a single node or an array. Every value taught there validates, so they are left as they are: incomplete, not wrong. The block is also in `check:doc-fences`' declared debt, so no gate reads it.
- **Two related readings are handed to the seat in the dispatch report and are not fixed here:** the "Settings Page with Tabs" snippet on layout.md, and five `object-grid` nodes elsewhere in the docs that bind through `dataSource` without `objectName`.
